scenes: Kathmandu. A valley city warming fast, below the Himalayan ice.
In the 2010s, Himalayan glaciers lost ice sixty-five per cent faster.
Nepal adopted a national heatwave plan in 2024.
Heat in the mountains reaches every river that flows from them.
